_readme: THE FACTORY-LIVE MOD, for this project only. Drafted at gate 11 when the
owner chooses it as <RESUME_MECHANISM>. The OWNER merges these two keys into
the same project settings file as gate 2's allowlist (gitignored,
per-machine); the factory never writes that file.
enabledPlugins turns the mod on in this repo and nowhere else, so the build
seat and the monitor seat both load it. extraKnownMarketplaces lets a fresh
machine find the marketplace; Claude Code asks before it installs anything.
Even loaded, the mod does nothing until hooks/arm.py arms this repo. It writes
only its own files in the arming's state directory, never the journal.
Check: in a new session in this repo, `/factory` answers. Before arming it says
the session is in no armed repo; once the seat runs, it names the seat.
Delete this _readme key when you merge.
